facts.text: Everline sits in Olympic Valley at the base of Palisades Tahoe, home of the 1960 Winter Olympics.
facts.excerpt: nestled in Olympic Valley at the base of Palisades Tahoe, home of the 1960 Winter Olympics

facts.text: The resort is inspired by Tahoe's evergreen landscape and the historic railroad line that connected the region.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by Tahoe’s evergreen landscape and the historic railroad line that connected the region

facts.text: The resort has ski-in/ski-out access to Palisades Tahoe.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy ski-in/ski-out access to Palisades Tahoe ski resort, ideal for winter sports enthusiasts.

facts.text: The resort has a private ice rink and over six miles of Nordic trails.
facts.excerpt: Glide on our private ice rink and explore over six miles of Nordic trails.

facts.text: The Links at Everline is a championship Robert Trent Jones Jr. golf course at the base of Palisades Tahoe, surrounded by six Sierra peaks.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by six majestic Sierra peaks, The Links at Everline is a championship Robert Trent Jones Jr. golf course in Lake Tahoe that rests serenely at the base of Palisades Tahoe.

facts.text: The Spa at Everline is the only spa in Olympic Valley.
facts.excerpt: The Spa at Everline is the only spa in Olympic Valley

facts.text: The spa offers massages, body treatments and facials, with a heated Oasis Pool Complex and a fitness center with steam room and sauna.
facts.excerpt: Discover a range of massages, body treatments, and facials. Relax and rejuvenate with access to our heated Oasis Pool Complex, 24-hour fitness center, complete with steam room and sauna.

facts.text: The resort has year-round heated outdoor swimming pools and Jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: Outside Year-Round Heated Swimming Pools

facts.text: The Oasis Pool Complex has a heated lap pool, a waterslide and whirlpools.
facts.excerpt: Splash into our Oasis Pool Complex with a heated lap pool, waterslide, and whirlpools.

facts.text: Summer outdoor options include guided hikes, bike rides, fly-fishing in private ponds and paddleboarding on Lake Tahoe.
facts.excerpt: Explore the outdoors with guided hikes, bike rides, fly-fishing in private ponds, or paddleboarding on Lake Tahoe.

facts.text: Winter activities include cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, sledding, ice skating and broomball, weather permitting.
facts.excerpt: cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, sledding, ice skating, broomball, swimming, and more - all weather permitting

facts.text: Rooms and suites have views of the Sierra Nevada, pine forests and meadows.
facts.excerpt: Relax in rooms and suites with panoramic views of the Sierra Nevada, pine forests, and meadows.

facts.text: Accommodations include fireplace suites and penthouses, all with custom furnishings, granite vanities and LED flat-screen TVs.
facts.excerpt: Choose from an array of rooms and suites, including fireplace suites and penthouses, all featuring custom furnishings, granite vanities, and LED flat-screen TVs.

facts.text: Penthouses have grand picture windows with views of Olympic Valley and its surrounding peaks.
facts.excerpt: grand picture windows framing stunning views of Olympic Valley and its surrounding peaks

facts.text: Fireplace suites have gas fireplaces, a resort kitchenette and a dining area.
facts.excerpt: a resort kitchenette, dining area, cozy gas fireplace, and valley views

facts.text: Six Peaks Grille is the resort's signature steakhouse, with premium cuts, fresh seafood and seasonal accompaniments.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in bold flavors at Six Peaks Grille, Everline’s signature steakhouse. Under the guidance of Chef Watkins, the menu showcases premium cuts, fresh seafood, and seasonal accompaniments

facts.text: Six Peaks Grille won Wine Spectator's 2025 Award of Excellence.
facts.excerpt: Six Peaks Grille is proud to be a winner of Wine Spectator’s 2025 Award of Excellence

facts.text: Complimentary shuttles run daily to Palisades Tahoe and seasonally to Tahoe City.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary shuttles make exploring Tahoe easy, with daily service to Palisades Tahoe, seasonal service to Tahoe City

facts.text: Offerings are subject to change based on weather conditions, and advance reservations may be required.
facts.excerpt: Please note that offerings are subject to change based on weather conditions, and advance reservations may be required.

facts.text: Guests must be 18 or over to receive spa services.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be age 18 or over to receive services.

facts.text: Mobile phones are not permitted in the spa or fitness center.
facts.excerpt: we do not permit the use of mobile phones in the spa or fitness center

facts.text: The shopping promenade has boutiques with resort wear, sporting apparel and outdoor gear.
facts.excerpt: Our shopping promenade offers a variety of boutiques ranging from designer resort wear and logo merchandise, to brand name sporting apparel and outdoor gear.

facts.text: The spa has a sanctuary lounge for relaxing before and after treatments.
facts.excerpt: Spa sanctuary, offering a warm, comfortable space to help you relax before and after treatments
